import hashlib
import json

from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

TCA = TypeAdapter(ToolCalls)

# ---------------- Task 1: validate_input normalization ----------------
# 1. canonical dict passthrough
d = {"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}
assert ToolCalls.validate_input(d) == d

# 2. single object
assert ToolCalls.validate_input({"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}) == {
    "tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]
}

# 3. bare list
lst = [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}, {"name": "bar", "args": {"b": 2}}]
assert ToolCalls.validate_input(lst) == {"tool_calls": lst}

# 4. JSON strings
assert ToolCalls.validate_input('{"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}') == {
    "tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]
}
assert ToolCalls.validate_input('{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}') == {
    "tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]
}
assert ToolCalls.validate_input('[{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]') == {
    "tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]
}

# 5. non-JSON string unchanged
assert ToolCalls.validate_input("not json at all") == "not json at all"
assert ToolCalls.validate_input('123') == '123'

# 6. returns plain structures, not ToolCalls instances
r = ToolCalls.validate_input({"name": "foo", "args": {}})
assert not isinstance(r, ToolCalls) and isinstance(r, dict)

# 7. end-to-end via TypeAdapter for every variant
for variant in [
    {"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]},
    {"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}},
    [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}, {"name": "bar", "args": {}}],
    '{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}',
    '[{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}, {"name": "bar", "args": {"b": 2}}]',
    '{"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}',
]:
    model = TCA.validate_python(variant)
    assert isinstance(model, ToolCalls)
    assert model.tool_calls[0].name == "foo"
    assert model.tool_calls[0].args == {"a": 1}

# existing construction still works
m = ToolCalls(tool_calls=[ToolCalls.ToolCall(name="get_weather", args={"city": "Paris"})])
assert m.tool_calls[0].name == "get_weather"
assert m.format()[0]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]["name"] == "get_weather"

# from_dict_list still works
m2 = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}])
assert m2.tool_calls[0].name == "search"

# equality between from_dict_list and direct construction
assert m2 == ToolCalls(
    tool_calls=[ToolCalls.ToolCall(name="search", args={"query": "hello"})]
)

# ---------------- Task 2: fingerprints ----------------
TC = ToolCalls.ToolCall

tc = TC(name="foo", args={"a": 1, "b": 2})
assert isinstance(tc.fingerprint, str) and len(tc.fingerprint) == 64
assert all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in tc.fingerprint)
assert tc.id == tc.fingerprint[:8] and len(tc.id) == 8

# expected hash per spec
expected = hashlib.sha256(
    json.dumps({"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1, "b": 2}}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()
assert tc.fingerprint == expected, (tc.fingerprint, expected)

# arg order invariance
tc_rev = TC(name="foo", args={"b": 2, "a": 1})
assert tc_rev.fingerprint == tc.fingerprint
assert tc_rev.id == tc.id

# nested dict key order invariance
tc_nested1 = TC(name="foo", args={"x": {"b": 2, "a": 1}})
tc_nested2 = TC(name="foo", args={"x": {"a": 1, "b": 2}})
assert tc_nested1.fingerprint == tc_nested2.fingerprint

# tuple -> list invariance
tc_tuple = TC(name="foo", args={"x": (1, 2)})
tc_list = TC(name="foo", args={"x": [1, 2]})
assert tc_tuple.fingerprint == tc_list.fingerprint

# nested tuple in list
tc_nt1 = TC(name="foo", args={"x": [(1, 2), (3, 4)]})
tc_nt2 = TC(name="foo", args={"x": [[1, 2], [3, 4]]})
assert tc_nt1.fingerprint == tc_nt2.fingerprint

# string whitespace trimming
tc_ws1 = TC(name="foo", args={"s": "  hello  "})
tc_ws2 = TC(name="foo", args={"s": "hello"})
assert tc_ws1.fingerprint == tc_ws2.fingerprint
# original args untouched
assert tc_ws1.args == {"s": "  hello  "}

# bool/number types preserved (no coercion)
tc_bool = TC(name="foo", args={"b": True, "n": 1.5})
expected_bool = hashlib.sha256(
    json.dumps({"name": "foo", "args": {"b": True, "n": 1.5}}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
).hexdigest()
assert tc_bool.fingerprint == expected_bool

# name is part of the fingerprint
assert TC(name="foo", args={"a": 1}).fingerprint != TC(name="bar", args={"a": 1}).fingerprint

# different args -> different fingerprints
assert TC(name="foo", args={"a": 1}).fingerprint != TC(name="foo", args={"a": 2}).fingerprint

# fingerprint not updated after args mutation
tc_m = TC(name="foo", args={"a": 1})
fp_before = tc_m.fingerprint
tc_m.args["a"] = 999
assert tc_m.fingerprint == fp_before
assert tc_m.args == {"a": 999}

# from_dict_list computes fingerprints
m3 = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}])
assert m3.tool_calls[0].fingerprint and len(m3.tool_calls[0].fingerprint) == 64
assert m3.tool_calls[0].id == m3.tool_calls[0].fingerprint[:8]

# nested validation through TypeAdapter also populates fingerprints (custom __init__ used)
m4 = TCA.validate_python({"tool_calls": [{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}]})
assert m4.tool_calls[0].fingerprint == m3.tool_calls[0].fingerprint

# model_copy keeps fingerprint
m5 = m3.model_copy()
assert m5.tool_calls[0].fingerprint == m3.tool_calls[0].fingerprint

# ToolCalls round-trip equality (both sides compute identical fingerprints)
assert m3 == ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}])

# validate_input passthrough of existing instance
assert ToolCalls.validate_input(m3) is m3

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
